rationale: Independent confidence development for user and device provides the evidentiary mechanism that underpins the network agent construct as the marriage of user, device, and application.
The network agent defines the atomic unit of authorization (user+device+app) that the three-layer model enforces across application, account, and network levels.
Cross-cutting capabilities (visibility & analytics, automation & orchestration, governance) operationalize enforcement across the three authorization layers.
Extends the three-layer model by specifying that for server-to-server contexts, the identity foundation shifts from IAM to CMDB while still enforcing at the network layer.
Visibility & analytics feeds the independent confidence tracking; automation & orchestration enables confidence aggregation at policy enforcement time.
